addressBasis: Unslid Mach-O virtual address; authenticated chained pointer target shown without high fixup bits

resolution.meaning: When both base and base+_Post2015 assets exist and priority is2, resolve to the suffixed asset and assign its runtime name to the original reference. When the original is absent the method returns null; it does not resolve a suffixed-only entry.

nativeCaller.meaning: Both loops call IAssetDeSerializer vtable0x38 with w2=2

productRule: Resolve the base identity; if it exists, prefer the exactly suffixed identity. Validate selected asset role, definition ID and library ID exactly. Retain both original persisted asset names and every typed asset payload for re-emission; do not rewrite body identities.
